Position Details: 
 Title: Software Developer
 Location: Denver, CO
 Duration: 6 month (may extend)
 

 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Develop Windows based applications for our Litigation solution offering leveraging Web Site, Web Service, Windows Service and other related technologies. 
 • Create enterprise-level software that interacts with Active Directory, MS SQL databases, Citrix environments and other third party components. 
 • Partner with our central operations team and data center organization on delivering enhancements to our environment and applications. 
 


 Qualifications: 
 • Experience with C#, SQL 
 • Familiar with source control systems, like TFS. 
 • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills and a high degree of attention to detail. 
 

 Bonus: 
 • Citrix experience 
 • Javascript 
 • Experience supporting applications in a highly distributed, enterprise environment. 
 • Experience using Visual Studio 2010/2012 and TFS Source Control
